title: Move docs sites (Kanbus mkdocs, Tactus, Biblicus, Cyclotron docs) to Papyrus Markus publications
description: Kanbus uses mkdocs; Tactus, Biblicus and Cyclotron keep docs/ trees. Decide one docs pattern (a docs-flavored Markus publication with sidebar nav) then convert each. Needs Markus directive coverage for admonitions, code tabs and API reference first.
